title: Clear only the exact claim seen under the cell lock
action: Fix the late owner-blind claim clear (claim-clear-identity D1, D2; contract claim-clear-identity). Today release_claim_file_best_effort(root, id) in packages/bee-rs/crates/bee/src/verbs/cells/claims.rs removes whatever claim file exists, and its callers run it after the cells:<id> lock is released: mutate_cell and cap_cell_from_flags in handlers_close.rs, and the NEEDS_REVISION reopen in handlers_meta.rs (record judge verdict). Change it so the caller reads the claim's acquired_at while it still holds the cells:<id> lock, and the clear (under the existing claim gate, re-reading the file) removes the file only when it still carries that same acquired_at. A claim absent under the lock clears nothing. Keep it best-effort: every failure is swallowed as today. Every caller passes what it read under its lock; find all callers with rg and change each. Tests in the cells test module, written and run red first against the current code before the fix: (1) a cell claimed by s1 whose claim file is replaced, after the snapshot, by a newer claim (different acquired_at) keeps the newer file after the clear; (2) the same claim with only claimed_at changed (a renew) is removed; (3) no claim at snapshot time and a claim written afterwards survives; (4) end to end, cells cap / unclaim / reopen on a cell still remove the cell's own claim file as before. No code comments.

truths: a claim written after the under-lock read survives the clear
the claim seen under the lock is removed, also after a renew changed claimed_at
a claim absent under the lock means the clear removes nothing
cap, unclaim and reopen still remove the cell's own claim file
